title: Precision Retrieval
visual_prompt: A split-screen view in 8k. Left: A terminal window where 'c3_search' and 'c3_read' commands are typed, with results appearing as surgical, golden glowing highlights. Right: A 3D wireframe representation of a codebase where a specific module is isolated, extracted, and 'shrunk' into a dense, glowing memory cube. The atmosphere is high-tech laboratory style, with clean surfaces and soft ambient blue lighting.
camera_movement: Side-to-side slider move between the terminal and the 3D codebase, followed by a macro lens zoom on the 'Memory Cube'.
sound_design: Clean, rhythmic mechanical keyboard clicks (ASMR style) synchronized with the code highlights. Digital 'scanning' noises and a satisfying high-frequency 'lock' sound on extraction.
